findingClass: the post-listing price job's own 'run complete' log line shows candidates > 0 and priced (updated+confirmed+unchanged+stale) === 0 for 3 consecutive runs on a slot -- the starved-rotation shape (listed-rotation-stall) where a front-pinned block of never-priceable rows exhausts the job's deadline before any priceable row is reached
failThreshold: the newest PRICE_JOB_ZERO_PRICED_STREAK_THRESHOLD (3) run-complete lines per slot all have candidates>0 and priced===0
unverifiableWhen: the slot's wake log file is not present or unreadable on this host (expected on a dev machine or CI; the same per-slot log the scraper-wake checks read, populated by cron redirecting the scraper's own stdout)
